purpose: Privacy-minimized schema for converting future operator confirmations into reviewable structured facts without committing raw correspondence to the public repository.

privacy_policy.rule: Store only business facts needed for HOY verification, authority classification, timestamps and an opaque evidence reference. Raw correspondence and unnecessary personal data stay outside the public repository.

decision_rules: A response record never changes runtime data directly.
Only fields explicitly answered by an accepted authority may move from unanswered.
A general statement such as 'everything is correct' does not verify individual unresolved fields unless the operator clearly references the supplied facts.
If a direct answer conflicts with existing material evidence, use conflict_review instead of silently overwriting history.
If a required Family premise is confirmed false, use remove_from_family_candidate_review.
eligible_for_release_review is only a review eligibility state; a separate reviewed data change is still required.
Never copy raw email text, signatures, personal names or private contact details into this public repository.
